## Overview
The insulated ceramic mug is designed for desk use, keeping drinks warm for up to 90 minutes. Its ceramic body suits everyday coffee and tea routines.

## Highlights
- Keeps drinks warm for 90 minutes
- Dishwasher safe
- Fits under most coffee machines

## Who it is for
Remote workers who spend the day at a desk and want a mug that holds warmth through long work sessions and is easy to clean.
